recognize_zh: 五格血片中的淋巴球核偏圓或腎形、染色質均勻，細胞質淡藍且周邊呈毛絨絨、細絲狀的突起（hairy projections），這是毛細胞白血病型態；標題特別強調在兒童身上出現，屬罕見情境，需以免疫表型確認。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Circumferential fine, frayed cytoplasmic projections (hairy/ruffled borders)
Round to oval, eccentric nuclei with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin
No conspicuous nucleoli in the high-power panels
Background red cells without evident blasts at low power
describe_en: Composite peripheral blood smear (panels A–E) shows scattered atypical lymphoid cells at low power (A, B) with detailed views at high power (C–E). The cells are medium-sized with oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin without prominent nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine, circumferential hair-like projections. The morphology is that of hairy cells; given the pediatric setting, where hairy cell leukemia is exceptionally rare, confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is required. Findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia in an unusual age group.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a distinct nucleolus and are CD25-/CD123- and BRAF V600E wild-type, whereas classic HCL shows no prominent nucleolus and is CD25+/CD123+/BRAF-mutated.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar projections with more condensed chromatin rather than circumferential fine hairs, and lack CD103/annexin A1.
Reactive large granular or activated lymphocytes lack the uniform circumferential projections and the clonal HCL immunophenotype.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, gray cytoplasm with fine vacuoles, and express CD14/CD64 rather than B-cell markers.
